model.name: Nike Air Futura T-Shirt - Men's
model.description:
Get a versatile look that adds an ‘Air’ of sophistication to your overall style with the Nike Air Futura T-Shirt. Made with lightweight and breathable fabric, this T-shirt keeps you relaxed and recharged from sun-up to sun-down. Whether it’s a weekend getaway or a binge-watching night at your friend’s house, the Nike Air Futura T-Shirt has your back for everything fun and casual.

  • 100% cotton. Imported.

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx: If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit., | If you don't have a tape measure, you can use a piece of string and measure it with a ruler.
